|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Elemental Weakness''' is a [[Hex]] [[spell]] that [[curse]]s all targets in an area, lowering their [[elemental damage|elemental]] [[Resistance]]. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== * '''Negative Resistances:''' This curse can cause resistance values to dip into the negatives, if the base values are low enough. This will have the affect of increasing the damage above values listed on the [[character screen]]. For example, if a monster has 0% elemental resistances by default (as well as 100% curse effectiveness) and is inflicted with level 1 Elemental Weakness, that monster now has -20% (negative 20%) elemental resistances. Consequently, the monster thus receives 20% more [[elemental damage]] than the [[spell]] or [[attack]] would normally cause. The curse gets even more effective against monsters with higher [[resistance]]s. * The extra damage is multiplicative with other damage modifiers as it is considered to be the monsters damage mitigation, and not due to a buff on any players' elemental skills damage. * Elemental Weakness can be turned into an [[aura]] by linking it with either {{il|Blasphemy Support}} or {{il|Awakened Blasphemy Support}}. Resistance |c2_header = Cursed enemies have x% to Elemental Resistances |c2_pattern_extract = Cursed enemies have (%-%d+)%% to Elemental Resistances |c2_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Unique items== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= item_stats.id LIKE "%elemental_weakness%" OR items.name LIKE "Soul Mantle" OR items.name LIKE "Ylfeban's Trickery" |level=1 |stat=1 |large=1 }} ==Related modifiers== The following mods are related to Elemental Weakness: {{Query spawnable modifiers |where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%elemental%weakness%" AND domain = 1 AND mods.generation_type NOT LIKE "10" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} These Synthesis implicit are able to find in pre-[[synthesised item]] or added via [[Harvest]] mechanics: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%elemental%weakness%" AND mods.id LIKE "%SynthesisImplicit%" |stat_text=1 |level=1 }} ===Legacy modifiers=== The following modifiers can only be found on legacy items in permanent leagues: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%elemental%weakness%" AND domain = 1 |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |spawn_weights=1 }} {{Skill enchantment modifier list|skill=Elemental Weakness}} ==Area mods== {{main|List of map suffix mods}} Elemental Weakness is one of the [[curse]]s that can be rolled on tier 6+ [[maps]] and [[vaal side area]]s (known as "secret_area" in spawn weight table below). The [[curse]] affects the entire area and cannot be removed. The debuff applied is not a skill, but has values equivalent to a curse from a level 1 skill gem. Its effect is not modified by {{c|mod|increased effect of Modifiers on your (Non-Unique) Maps}}. It can be mitigated with the upgraded [[Soul of Yugul]] or other item modifiers that offer {{c|mod|reduced/less effect of curses on you}}. {{Query spawnable modifiers |where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%elemental%weakness%" AND domain = 5 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} ===Heist and Grand Heist modifiers=== {{Query spawnable modifiers |where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%elemental%weakness%" AND domain = 22 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} ====Legacy map mods==== The following map mods can only be find in legacy map item in permanent leagues: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%elemental%weakness%" AND domain = 5 |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |spawn_weights=1 }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides 0-20% increased Duration of Elemental Ailments on Cursed Enemies, instead of 0-10% increased Effect of Curse. }} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| *Now causes {{c|mod|Cursed enemies have -('''15-30''')% to Elemental Resistances}} (previously -(20-39)%). *Quality no longer grants {{c|mod|Cursed enemies have -(0.25-5)% to Elemental Resistances}}. **Instead, it now grants {{c|mod|(0-10)% increased Effect of Curse}}. *Now have a base duration of ('''8-11.8''') seconds (previously (9-10.9) seconds). *Anomalous quality no longer grants {{c|mod|(0-10)% increased Effect of Curse}}. **Instead, it now grants {{c|mod|(0-20)% increased Curse Duration}}. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0f| * Map Curse modifiers no longer have increased effect. This was a restartless deploy of the patch so you will need to restart your client to receive the client changes, specifically the Map Curse modifier change requires a client restart to visually update descriptions. }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| '' All curse skills have been reworked and are now divided into two categories: Hexes and Marks.'' * Hexes apply a curse in an area and, when manually cast, apply an amount of Doom per second to cursed enemies up to a maximum. Doom increases the effect of the afflicted curse and stacks additively with modifiers to increased Curse effect. * Items which apply a Curse to an enemy{{efn|name=Bex}} (such as the curse-on-hit Ring modifiers) no longer specify a level, and instead have a set magnitude for their values with a fixed amount of Doom, which is overwritten when another source applies a more potent version (similar to Arcane Surge). *'''Elemental Weakness''': Curses applied by casting this spell now gain 10 Doom per second. }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 16 (was 24). * Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 33 (was 50). }} {{Version history table row|2.6.0| * Increased Area of Effect mod and its progression per level doubled. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Mana cost reduced at all levels. Area of effect increases per gem level reduced, but the base area of effect has been increased by 37.5% (from 16 to 22). It now grants 0.25% reduced elemental resistances on cursed enemies per 1% quality (was 0.4% per 1% quality). }} {{Version history table row|1.2.0| * Now gains -8% Enemy Resistances at 20% quality, instead of -10% at 20% quality. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.4e| * Fixed a bug where [[Chance to Ignite]] did not scale properly under Elemental Weakness. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.2| * Added new skill prototype - "Elemental Weakness": Curses all targets in an area, making them less resistant to elemental damage and more vulnerable to elemental status effects. }} {{Version history table end}} ==Notes== {{notelist|refs={{efn|name=Bex|The patch notes are not clear. Bex_GGG later clarified that this change also effects items that curse players, such as {{il|Soul Mantle}}.{{cite web|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/ivdd5m/soul_mantle_nerf_not_listed_in_patch_notes/g5r48ni/?context=10|title=Re: Soul Mantle Nerf not Listed in Patch Notes?|author=Bex_GGG|date=September 18, 2020|accessdate=March 14, 2021|publisher=Official Path of Exile subreddit}} The patch notes did not mention the map curse either, which also affected by this change.}} }} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{math|formula= \begin{align} \text{dmg}_{\text{red} } & = (1 - \text{Resistance}) * \text{dmg} \end{align} }} {{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a5WV-MoCQHQ|title=Path of Exile: Damage & Elemental Resistance Mechanics|date=June 4, 2017|accessdate=March 2, 2010|author= Engineering Eternity|publisher=Youtube}} }} {{Navbox Skills}} {{sister|poe2wiki}}
